summary.name: RustDesk
summary.one_liner: RustDesk is open-source remote desktop software that can be run on your own self-hosted server, positioned as an alternative to TeamViewer and AnyDesk.
use_cases: Remote IT support for end users
Remote work access to office computers
Self-hosting a private remote access server
Replacing TeamViewer or AnyDesk with an on-premise tool
Unattended access to Linux machines under Wayland (preview)
Hosting a branded web client on your own domain
summary.what_it_does: RustDesk is remote desktop software whose servers can be deployed on your own infrastructure, with the page describing it as a self-hosted alternative to commercial tools. The page gives a three-step Docker setup: install Docker, download a compose.yml (open-source or pro variant), and run docker compose up -d. It states that more than 90 options can be configured and that the client can be personalized with your own name, icon and logo. Version 1.5.0 is described as adding WebRTC connection paths, direct access from the web client, and QoS updates for delay, congestion and FPS targets. A preview for x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu adds unattended Wayland access.
notable: Self-hosted server deployable via Docker Compose
Client can be rebranded with own name, icon and logo
Web client can be hosted on your own domain
Listed as Freeware and open source in awesome-mac
caveats: Wayland unattended access is only a preview and only for x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu-based systems
Page warns that rustdesk.com is the only official domain and users should not download from other domains
Pricing is not stated on the page; the pro compose variant is mentioned without details
